newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank cuts o/night borrowing to 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank cuts o/night borrowing to 25 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it was cutting its overnight borrowing rate to 25 percent from 28 percent effective July 18.
Rates of five-day, two-week and one-month term reverse repos were also cut to 18 percent from 22 percent.
Other term reverse repos were kept unchanged.
Central bank governor Gabriel Singson did not say whether the overnight lending rate had also been cut from its present 30 percent.
"As the market stabilises, we will correspondingly reduce interest rates," Singson told reporters.
